design: Medium muscular herald with a wide arched forehead, substantial four mandibles and thick short dreadlocks tied at varying lengths. Ivory double-breasted civic tunic with bold crimson edging, long asymmetric rear cloth panel and wide belt. Hands resting on belt edges, prominent bronze civic badge on chest, compact curved announcement horn hanging from a strong side strap. Sage-green mottled scales, neutral welcoming posture.
